falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 75% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,800 would violate the August 2024 bottom's key support level and invalidate the bottoming pattern thesis, suggesting continuation lower rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX spike above 25 would indicate panic selling and systemic stress inconsistent with a bottom formation; the August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 22 and rapidly declining, so this would signal a different regime (capitulation/bear continuation) rather than the expected stabilization

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further below -50 basis points (currently approximately -15 to -20 bps)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion would signal escalating recession probability and financial stress, directly contradicting the bottom_2024_aug pattern which occurred during yield curve steepening; this would prove the macro environment is deteriorating into risk-off rather than recovering

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
